question: In the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections, how many seats did the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) secure out of the total constituencies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**34 out of 81**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections, the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) secured **34 seats** out of a total of 81 constituencies.
 
• The Jharkhand Assembly consists of **81 seats**, representing various constituencies across the state.
 
• JMM is a major regional political party in Jharkhand, advocating for tribal rights and state welfare policies.
 
• The performance of JMM in the 2024 elections indicates its continued influence in Jharkhand's political landscape.
 
• The party's electoral strategy and alliances played a crucial role in achieving this result.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand Legislative Assembly:**

 
 
• The Jharkhand Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) is the unicameral legislature of the Indian state of Jharkhand.
 
• It consists of 81 members, who are elected directly by the people through a single-member constituency system.
 
• The assembly's term is five years unless dissolved earlier.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM):**
 
 
• Founded in 1972 by Shibu Soren, JMM is a prominent political party in Jharkhand.
 
• The party primarily focuses on the rights of tribal communities, socio-economic development, and environmental conservation.
 
• JMM has been instrumental in the movement for the creation of Jharkhand as a separate state in 2000.
 
 
 
• **2024 Jharkhand Assembly Elections:**
 
 
• The elections were held to elect representatives for the 81 constituencies of the Jharkhand Assembly.
 
• Major parties included JMM, BJP, Congress, and regional parties.
 
• Voter turnout and key issues, such as tribal welfare, employment, and infrastructure, shaped the election results.
 
 
 
• **Political Landscape of Jharkhand:**
 
 
• Jharkhand has a mix of tribal and non-tribal populations, influencing its political dynamics.
 
• Coalition governments are common in the state due to the fragmented political scenario.
 
• Key issues include mining rights, tribal welfare, and rural development.
